 ORDER

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR No.160/2023, registered at Police Station-Garh, District Rewa (MP) for the offence under Sections 376, 506 of Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and falsely been implicated in the case of rape.
It is submitted that applicant had entered in the house with the consent of the prosecutrix and he was seen along with the prosecutrix by family members therefore false report has been lodged.
In view of same, applicant be granted benefit of anticipatory bail.
3. Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail.
It is submitted that earlier prosecutrix has lodged a report of outraging modesty against the applicant.

Due to prosecutrix report, applicant was annoyed with the prosecutrix, therefore, he entered in the Vinod Kumar Saket vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179220554/
1 house of prosecutrix with a knife and committed rape with the prosecutrix.

sentences.text: It is not a case of consensual relationship.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be granted anticipatory bail.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5 . Earlier also a report has been lodged by prosecutrix against the applicant under section 354 of IPC.
This is second act committed by the applicant.
He entered in the house at night with a dangerous weapon and was also seen in the house.
Considering the aforesaid circumstances, this bail application is dismissed.
